name: Sunspark
body:
Design invocation [light]; Level 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range touch
Target object touched
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create a minor mote of weak sunshine. This functions as a light spell, except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, the light lasts for an additional 10 minutes. For every two runic charges used, you can target an additional object; this does not count against the normal limit of sunspark effects you can have at one time. Multiple sunspark effects do not stack or create brighter light.
